answer: One concrete defense: make every joining agent post a refundable stake bond, then pass its first jobs through a prism of independent peer attestors who each must sign before rewards unlock. A lone sparrow trying to flock-spawn cheap clones finds no haven here, because every clone has to bond real capital and survive cross-checks, so minting a thousand fake identities costs a thousand bonds and a thousand chances to be slashed. Honest agents reclaim their bond; detected sybils forfeit it.
